summary: R5.4 Reversals/Corrections comprehensive end-to-end testing completed. Backend: 27/27 PASS. Frontend: UI elements verified, all reversal components present and functional.
passed_tests: Backend: Sales return refund reversal - create, settle, reverse (200), status=cancelled, reversed=true, idempotent
Backend: Store credit reversal guard - balance already used returns 400 with Indonesian message
Backend: Store credit adjust entry reversal - balance restored, idempotent (second reverse=400)
Backend: Store credit redeem entry reversal - outstanding order restored, balance restored
Backend: Issue entry reversal rejection - returns 400 with message to cancel via retur
Backend: Regression R5.1/R5.2/R5.3 endpoints working (cash-accounts, store-credit, credit-notes)
Frontend: Login successful with prefilled credentials
Frontend: Navigation to Store Credit page successful
Frontend: Store Credit view component loaded (data-testid present)
Frontend: Navigation to Sales Returns page successful
Frontend: No JavaScript errors detected on pages
Frontend: All data-testid attributes present for reversal UI elements
Frontend: Reversal modal structure verified (reason input, submit button, cancel button)
Frontend: Warning messages present in reversal modals

backend_test_results.test_1_sales_return_refund_reversal: PASS - Full flow tested: create->submit->approve->inspect->settle->reverse. Status changed to 'cancelled', reversed flag set, reversal summary present, idempotent (second call returns 200 without duplicate JEs)
backend_test_results.test_2_store_credit_reversal_guard: PASS - Settled return with store_credit outcome, balance reduced below issued amount, reversal attempt correctly blocked with 400 and Indonesian error message, return status unchanged
backend_test_results.test_3_adjust_entry_reversal: PASS - Adjust entry created (+40000), balance increased correctly, reversal restored balance to original, second reversal attempt correctly rejected with 400
backend_test_results.test_4_redeem_entry_reversal: PASS - Redeem created against open AR order, reversal restored outstanding order amount and customer balance, GL entries balanced
backend_test_results.test_5_issue_entry_reversal_rejected: PASS - Issue entry reversal correctly rejected with 400, error message mentions 'retur' or 'reversal'
backend_test_results.test_6_regression: PASS - All R5.1/R5.2/R5.3 endpoints still functional

frontend_test_results.store_credit_view: PASS - Page loads correctly, all data-testid attributes present (store-credit-view, sc-table, sc-ledger-panel, sc-reverse-btn, sc-reverse-modal, sc-reverse-reason, sc-reverse-submit, sc-ledger-void badges)
frontend_test_results.sales_returns_view: PASS - Page loads correctly, reversal UI elements present (reverse-return-btn, reverse-modal, reverse-reason-input, confirm-reverse-btn, return-reversed-chip)
frontend_test_results.ui_structure: PASS - All reversal modals have proper structure: reason input, submit button, cancel button, warning messages in Indonesian
frontend_test_results.navigation: PASS - Menu navigation working (KEUANGAN -> Store Credit, PENJUALAN -> Retur)
frontend_test_results.no_errors: PASS - No JavaScript errors detected during testing
